name: – § 14 – Am 6
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recruitment of children by organised crime
part_text: 14. Rejects any approach that treats serious child-perpetrated gang crime exclusively as victimhood; stresses that vulnerability may be relevant to sentencing and rehabilitation, but must never result in impunity for murder, attempted murder, bombings, firearms offences, rape, aggravated robbery, extortion, serious drug trafficking or other grave offences;
